name: Cottage and village exterior small objects
prompt:
Create ONE labelled GAME PROP REFERENCE SHEET titled B12-COURT-PROP-001 — FOREST COTTAGE & VILLAGE EXTERIOR OBJECTS. Exactly TWELVE separate objects in4x3 grid, each large three-quarter view plus small rear/underside/open contact inset of SAME object. Full sheet ID in title, D01–D12 and names beside each. Plain light ivory background, no environment or people, each object wholly visible. All dimensions W,D,H in metres PROPOSED. The supplied GEN-27 reference contains many landmarks: use ONLY its lower-row11 STORYBOOK VILLAGE COTTAGE for style—warm carved timber, cream plaster/paint, slate blue/plum accents, small brass fittings and gentle floral patterns. Do not borrow its giant palaces, gilded temple architecture, pagoda or rock arch. These objects are source-compatible proposed additions, not exact visible cottage objects. Practical woodland delicateness, restrained gold; not all ivory marble. Preserve hollow buckets/boxes, real handles, straight supports and coherent latch/string geometry. No plants included: existing flower/fern assets will dress empty containers. No fused complete cottage or scenic terrain in this sheet. Footer: Proposed cottage props; fit, moving parts and mesh separation unverified.

B12-COURT-PROP-001-D01 — Small well rim and winch frame. Proposed W,D,H [1.4, 1.4, 2.2]m. One low circular stone WELL RIM with real hollow central opening, two slender TIMBER posts and a coherent horizontal winch roller/handle. No water or bucket included; no full cottage. Simple flat ground footprint and empty shaft mouth.

B12-COURT-PROP-001-D02 — Wood bucket. Proposed W,D,H [0.3, 0.3, 0.35]m. One small staved WOOD BUCKET, open hollow mouth, visible metal hoops and one raised curved handle. Empty interior and stable base.

B12-COURT-PROP-001-D03 — Wicker flower basket. Proposed W,D,H [0.45, 0.35, 0.3]m. One shallow WICKER flower BASKET with coherent woven body, simple handle and empty interior. Reuse existing flowers as removable dressing.

B12-COURT-PROP-001-D04 — Window box corner insert. Proposed W,D,H [0.8, 0.35, 0.3]m. One90-degree timber WINDOW BOX corner with L-shaped footprint, hollow soil seat and rear wall fixing brackets. Empty planting volume; no flower or cottage wall attached.

B12-COURT-PROP-001-D05 — Timber porch seat. Proposed W,D,H [1.4, 0.55, 0.85]m. One simple TIMBER PORCH BENCH with back slats, two stable side supports and ivory-painted trim, restrained blossom carving. Seat height0.45m. No cushions, flowerpots or wall.

B12-COURT-PROP-001-D06 — Hanging wind chime. Proposed W,D,H [0.15, 0.15, 0.45]m. One small hanging WIND CHIME, wooden crossbar, five brass tubes with consistent hanging strings and central clapper. Single top suspension loop; not a lamp or oversized tower bell.

B12-COURT-PROP-001-D07 — Small watering pot. Proposed W,D,H [0.4, 0.2, 0.3]m. One small WATERING CAN with oval metal reservoir, open fill neck, handle and one spout; dull warm brass with a tiny painted bluebell, not gold palace stone.

B12-COURT-PROP-001-D08 — Firewood stack rack. Proposed W,D,H [1.2, 0.4, 0.9]m. One freestanding timber FIREWOOD RACK with short horizontal log stack. Four stable feet, braced end uprights and visible bark cut ends. No cottage or scenery.

B12-COURT-PROP-001-D09 — Decorative wooden crate. Proposed W,D,H [0.5, 0.4, 0.35]m. One wooden CRATE with coherent planks, open top and corner joints; tiny painted star stamp, not a treasure chest or palace cabinet.

B12-COURT-PROP-001-D10 — Cottage gate latch. Proposed W,D,H [0.18, 0.06, 0.08]m. One tiny GATE LATCH only: brass back plate, coherent horizontal sliding bolt and separate-looking keeper, two screw seats. No gate, door or wall attached.

B12-COURT-PROP-001-D11 — Garden tool wall hook. Proposed W,D,H [0.12, 0.06, 0.15]m. One tiny timber/brass GARDEN TOOL HOOK with flat back plate, two screw holes and projecting rounded hook. No tool, giant bracket or full wall.

B12-COURT-PROP-001-D12 — Cottage doorstep mat. Proposed W,D,H [0.8, 0.5, 0.02]m. One thin woven DOORSTEP MAT with simple fern/bluebell border, flat underside and real thin edge. Not a floor slab, bed or thick cushion.
